statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. NQ is closed; Tail remains low while geopolitical, rate and oil Stress is extreme.
recommendation: Mapped policy state remains EA_ON; the Sunday Globex reopening is the principal conditional path-risk checkpoint.
headline: Low Tail during closure; reopening remains the main path-risk checkpoint
body: NQ remains closed, so persistent one-way structure cannot be observed. Saudi escalation, high yields and expensive crude keep Stress extreme; fresh supplementary context shows strong semiconductors but split megacaps, while unchanged China lending benchmarks limit incremental surprise.

lookbackSummary: Tail stayed low across all 24 prior hourly assessments, ranging from 10% to 16%. Stress remained high to extreme while the weekend closure prevented live confirmation of a pathological one-way NQ path.
outlookSummary: Tail remains low through the scheduled closure, rises conditionally into WATCH around the Sunday Globex reopening, and falls below WATCH in the base case only if early price discovery becomes two-way with meaningful retracements.

forecast.analysis: NQ is closed, so no live one-way or failed-retracement structure is observable. Fresh shared context shows semiconductor strength but split megacaps; Saudi escalation keeps Stress extreme while Tail remains low.
drivers: NQ closed; no live price-path confirmation
Fresh Finviz context: semiconductors positive, megacaps split

forecast.analysis: During the closure, new headlines could alter the eventual opening gap, but they cannot establish a future persistent NQ path before futures resume.
China's unchanged lending benchmarks matched expectations. Without new verified escalation, they add little incremental directional pressure to the eventual reopening.

forecast.analysis: With futures still closed, pullback depth and directional efficiency remain unknowable. The base case stays low Tail unless verified weekend shocks alter the setup.
Absent a new catalyst, the closure leaves Stress high but provides no evidence of mean-reversion failure. Reopening conditions remain the next meaningful checkpoint.
As the reopening approaches, headline sensitivity increases modestly. Tail stays below WATCH because no tradable NQ structure can yet confirm persistent extension.
Late-week rates, crude and mixed megacap breadth remain potential amplifiers, but they would matter for Tail only if the future opening path becomes unusually one-way.
drivers: High rates and oil as potential amplifiers

news.title: S&P 500, Nasdaq advance, turning the page on a tumultuous week

forecast.analysis: Gap uncertainty rises into the final hours before reopening. A larger energy or geopolitical shock could widen the opening range without by itself proving persistent Tail behavior.

news.title: Flames, smoke seen near Riyadh airport; Houthis claim attacks on Saudi capital

forecast.analysis: Pre-open risk remains dominated by unresolved weekend headlines. Tail rises slightly because the first tradable gap is closer, while directional persistence is still unobserved.
The final pre-open stretch carries more event sensitivity. A sharp gap would be a stress signal; Tail would require shallow retracements or repeated extension after trading begins.
In the last hour before Globex, conditional risk reaches the top of the low band. The opening gap and first retracement are the key tests for whether WATCH is warranted.
At the scheduled Globex reopening, WATCH reflects conditional gap and whipsaw risk. Persistence is not assumed; Tail would fall if the first moves retrace meaningfully and cross-assets do not align.

forecast.analysis: The second trading hour remains WATCH if early price discovery is disorderly. A failed first retracement plus renewed extension would keep Tail elevated; two-way trade would reduce it.

news.title: Flames, smoke seen near Riyadh airport; Houthis claim attacks on Saudi capital

forecast.analysis: Conditional WATCH persists while the opening structure is assessed. Repeated extension near session extremes would sustain concern; successful retracements would argue for normalization.
By 01:00 UTC, the base case falls below WATCH only if trading has become two-way and the initial gap is being absorbed rather than extended without meaningful pullbacks.

Into the Asian session, Tail is conditionally lower if the opening impulse has lost directional efficiency. Renewed extension with aligned oil, yields and tech leadership would invalidate that easing.
drivers: Oil, yields and technology alignment checkpoint

forecast.analysis: Further normalization assumes retracements continue to hold and no fresh geopolitical shock reopens the gap. Stress remains high because rates and energy risks are still material.
During early Asia, the base case keeps Tail low if price discovery remains balanced. A new one-way leg or repeated failed pullbacks would require reassessment.
Conditional risk eases as the reopening shock window recedes, provided cross-asset signals stay mixed rather than aligning with a persistent NQ move.
Approaching Europe, Tail remains low in the base case if overnight structure is two-way. A sustained move near extremes with semis, megacaps and yields aligned would be a contrary signal.
By the European morning, the forecast assumes no unresolved second leg from the reopening. Persistent extension or a fresh energy shock would invalidate that assumption and raise Tail.

forecastDetail.comment: NQ is closed; low Tail reflects absent live path evidence while Saudi escalation keeps Stress extreme.
Closure continues; headlines may change the eventual gap but cannot prove future one-way NQ structure.
Expected unchanged China lending rates add little incremental surprise; no live retracement test is available.
Friday's chip strength and weak breadth remain historical context, not proof of Sunday's future path.
Middle East headlines remain the main gap-risk checkpoint; Tail stays low without tradable persistence evidence.
Saudi Gulf export rerouting partly offsets supply pressure; future oil/NQ alignment remains conditional.
